stem: Which sentence from the story “Biking for Boots” shows that the girls have mixed feelings throughout their Lake Superior tour?
instruction: Use “Biking for Boots” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Shelby’s mom was going to be our support team on the road. (paragraph 8)

options.label: B
options.text: For the next month, our enthusiasm ebbed and flowed along with the demands of our bicycling experiences. (paragraph 9)

options.label: C
options.text: We had flat tires to repair after riding miles of roadways. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: Each evening I posted a log of our adventures on the animal shelter’s website. (paragraph 10)
